extension.news: 2026-09-18 - Summary of v1.3.5 (see Tools > Changelog for the detail): * Trakt Continue Watching uses the same progress feed as Red Light In Progress (Dropped excluded, live list) * Trakt Watched (TV) is completed shows only, not partially watched * Simkl Continue Watching is started shows only; Plan to Watch stays the Watchlist slot * Authorise in Account Settings is picked up without a Kodi restart * Dead Trakt / Simkl / MDBList / TMDb grants toast once: Revoke and Authorise again * Revoke Authorisation asks first; Account Settings stay open * Lists use InfoTag only (no ListItem.setInfo warnings) * My Trakt progress/watched shelves always show when authorised * HdHub drops Caped Crusader-style longer titles, wrong SxxExx, and nameless PixelDrain links
